name: Elementary
author: Kyle Arrington <kyle@arrington.co>
description: A reading window for learning the computer. Curriculum lives in a git repo you own or fork; the plugin renders it beside the terminal and remembers what has been read.

barWidget.description: Where you are in the curriculum; click to open the reader beside your terminal.

schema.label: Curriculum
schema.description: A git URL to clone, or a path to a folder on this machine. A local path is read in place and never pulled, so you can write lessons and see them immediately.

schema.label: Branch
schema.description: Only used when the source is a git URL.

schema.label: Pull new lessons automatically
schema.description: Fast-forward pulls only. If the network is down the last-cloned copy keeps working.

schema.label: Reading size
schema.description: Body text size in the reader window.
